purpose: Chrome Headless Shell for @remotion/renderer 4.0.543 (TESTED_VERSION). Installed only by scripts/remotion/install-browser.ps1; renders never download it.
sourceNote: The archive @remotion/renderer 4.0.543 itself downloads on win64 (dist/browser/get-chrome-download-url.js). Google Chrome for Testing publishes the same version at https://storage.googleapis.com/chrome-for-testing-public/158.0.8127.2/win64/chrome-headless-shell-win64.zip (a different archive, 128504099 bytes); it is not used.
